categories.main_business_segments: Colorlight Cloud Tech Ltd primarily operates in the video image display control industry, focusing on LED display control systems, video processing equipment, and cloud network players. Their products enable video signal and image data display control, editing, transmission, and analysis. The company serves various applications including large-scale events, broadcasting studios, command centers, commercial advertising, smart cities, and virtual production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as 5G, 8K, AI, Mini/Micro LED, COB packaging, and AVoverIP for video processing and display control. Key proprietary technologies include massive pixel rapid optical calibration, multi-route ultra-8K low-latency video processing, nonlinear color gamut calibration, virtual shooting XR technology, and distributed node election algorithms. Manufacturing involves PCB design, FPGA development, embedded software, and integrated hardware-software solutions with automated calibration systems like Mica.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are LED display manufacturers and downstream clients in sectors such as large-scale celebrations, sports events, conferences, exhibitions, monitoring and dispatch, TV broadcasting, performing arts, commercial advertising, information dissemination, creative displays, smart cities, virtual shooting, and automotive displays. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including North America, Europe, and emerging economies in Asia and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with domestic revenue accounting for approximately 89% of total sales. It has expanded its presence internationally with subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong, the United States, the Netherlands, South Korea, and Japan, targeting North American, European, and Asian markets. The company is actively developing its overseas market penetration and service capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Colorlight Cloud Tech Ltd operates at the midstream of the LED display industry supply chain as a manufacturer of display control systems and video processing equipment. It integrates upstream raw materials like chips and PCBs into finished control systems and sells these to downstream LED display manufacturers and end customers, providing installation, technical support, and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation driven by 5G+8K+AI technology integration, focusing on intelligent display control systems and MLED display terminals. It invests heavily in R&D to develop high-performance, high-resolution AI display control devices and cloud-based management platforms. Strategic priorities include expanding product lines, enhancing video processing capabilities, advancing virtual production technologies, and strengthening global market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of hardware products including LED display control systems (receiving cards and senders), video processing equipment, and cloud network players. The company also earns from software platform services and value-added technical support. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to LED manufacturers and supplemented by distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include international firms like Barco and domestic companies such as Xi'an Nova Star Technology Co., Ltd. Colorlight positions itself as a leading high-tech enterprise in the LED display control and video processing sector, recognized for its advanced proprietary technologies and strong market presence. It holds multiple patents and industry awards, maintaining a competitive edge through innovation and comprehensive product solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 642.9 million, a 36.97% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 19.3 million, down 90.45%. Despite short-term revenue decline due to domestic market softness, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D (up 27.99%) and expand overseas markets. Total assets stood at about RMB 2.65 billion with a stable equity base, reflecting a medium-sized enterprise with growth challenges but strong innovation capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Colorlight emphasizes its unique value through advanced video processing algorithms, high-precision optical calibration, and integrated hardware-software solutions that deliver superior image quality, low latency, and high reliability. Its proprietary technologies such as the CCM6000 calibration camera and Calibration Pro software enable rapid, precise calibration of LED displays, enhancing product quality and customer experience. The company also offers comprehensive solutions covering hardware, software, and cloud services, supporting diverse and complex application scenarios globally.
